title: Minimally Invasive C-Shaped incision as a novel approach for Endodontic Microsurgery: A case report
html: Endodontic microsurgery (EMS) is a well-established treatment for persistent periapical pathology when orthograde retreatment is not feasible or has failed. Surgical access is traditionally achieved using a sulcular or submarginal flap. However, these flap designs may be associated with aesthetic limitations and postoperative discomfort.
